faq.a: Salam is associated with the Arabic form سَلَام, whose core sense is salam; peace.

faq.q: What is the origin of Salam?
faq.a: Salam is associated with Arabic. Salam is Arabic سَلَام (Salām), meaning 'peace'; it occurs in the Quran.
Yes — the underlying form سَلَام is Arabic.
Salam can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Salam should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Salām occurs in the Quran as a term for peace.

faq.q: What does Salam mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Salam is rendered سلام and carries the sense سلام، امن.

faq.q: What does Salam mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Salam is rendered سلام and carries the sense سلام، صلح.
A romanized syllable approximation is sa-lam. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Salam?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Salam, salam. Script forms are سلام, سَلَام, सलाम.

faq.q: Is Salam a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
